declarations.description: Draggable, rotatable protractor overlay with two opposing 0-180 degree scales, for measuring angles in item content. The host shows it with `visible`; inside a toolkit runtime context it registers `tool-id` with the tool coordinator on the tool layer, which brings it to the front when pressed. Arrow keys move it, Shift+Arrow and PageUp/PageDown rotate it about its vertex, and tap controls shown while it has focus move and turn it without dragging.
declarations.name: ToolProtractor
